name: The nursery at the top of the house
description: A big airy room, nearly the whole floor, with barred windows that look all ways, rings in the walls, a heavy bed nailed to the floor, a scratched and gouged floor and a torn yellow wallpaper.

features.name: The wallpaper
features.description: A smouldering, unclean yellow, a sprawling pattern of curves that commit suicide, with a sub-pattern behind it like a woman stooping and creeping; torn in patches.

features.name: The great bed
features.description: Heavy, nailed down, gnawed at the corners.

features.name: The smooch
features.description: A long, even rubbed streak low on the wall that runs round the room behind everything but the bed.

features.name: Window to the garden
features.description: Looks at arbors and old flowers.

features.name: Window to the bay
features.description: Looks to the bay and a private wharf.

exits.description: the stairs, with a gate at the head
